text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—...Heheh.
I see.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
(Such an incredible level from everyone... Amazing!
So this is the strength of the Senior Class racers...)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yet!
I am... the strongest!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Tokyo Racecourse was trembling.
With a massive, echoing roar from the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: No way...! I-It can't be...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Gentildonna!
This year's Tiara Umamusume has...
defeated Orfevre, aaahhh?!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I told you, didn't I?
Power changes everything in an instant...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
“I am the victor.
Therefore—”

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...No, Gentil.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I commend thee.
For having run before Us.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Your power—
I have committed it to memory, without a doubt.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...
More importantly,

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Why aren't you kneeling, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You will need to closely imitate
my demeanor prior to a race.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I have shown you how to pay proper respect
to the truly strong."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
This is my throne.
—Bow your head.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh heh... Hahaha.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
For now, I shall withdraw.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I command you.
Run in the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The "Osaka Hai"... the championship race for spring medium-distance runners. Just like today, it's a GⅠ where the fierce competitors of the Senior tier gather.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Wait until then.
That throne... I shall let you borrow it for a little while longer.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to take it back, do so by force.
—Farewell, king of a bygone era.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Incredible... Isn't this the first time a girl from the Tiara route won the Japan Cup in her Classic year?! History was just made...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I can't really bring myself to celebrate.
Did you see how they treated Orfe?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Show some respect!
You're nothing like the Tiara Umamusume before you...
Seriously, no way...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text:
—Gentil-san...
You really are... so cool...!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to bend your knee to curry favor with anyone.
No forced smiles, either... You can stand proud.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text:
I have strength within me, and it's okay
to be proud of that. Just like you—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Gentildonna, having defeated the strongest
Umamusume and claimed victory. Just as I was
about to offer words of praise—"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Here you go.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Haven't I taught you proper manners
when addressing a lady before?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sensing what she wanted to say, I knelt before her... to show my utmost respect.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... Here you go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bringing her lips close to the glove,
she makes a soft kissing sound.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hohoho.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if
I've gotten a little used to this."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
As my Trainer...
I hope for your even greater dedication from here on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once the new year begins, she will be in the Senior Year.
We must make it a year that makes her power
even more widely known.
choice_data_list: Let's keep challenging the strongest competitors from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case,
shall we not head to the Osaka Hai first?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I received an invitation
from Orfe-san.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it the duty of a new king
to crush them into complete submission?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hohoho.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Please ensure you do not
forget that spirited determination.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Because power can only be grasped
by those who truly desire it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the next target race was decided: the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Phone Sound
text_block_list.text:
"—Strong, overwhelmingly strong Gentildonna!
Will we see a rematch with Orfevre
next year?"

text_block_list.name: Phone Sound
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre, thought to be the strongest in the nation, now has a new rival on the scene!
Next year is going to be exciting!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Rivals, huh...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Well, that was rather underwhelming.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
She's already... so far ahead.
Even before this, her back felt so distant.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...B... Big sister.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
What is it, Cheval?
At such a late hour.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah, umm... I couldn't sleep.
I was just taking a walk...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Geez.
You're as terrible a liar as ever.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...!
I-It's not a lie...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Gasp, this is...!
Tea...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Cheval.
Both Vivlos and you... are my pride.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It's pride.
That is why...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grip...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa!
B-Big sis...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'll become stronger.
I promise I will... so just for a little while—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst a swirl of varying emotions...
At the King's invitation, Gentildonna decided to make the
Osaka Hai her first goal for the Senior Class.
